recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with light gray background (#E8E8E8).
2. Add a thin red rectangular border (#C00000) around the slide content area.
3. Add a text box centered in the upper-middle with text: 'Update Weights of Hidden Layer'. Format as bold sans-serif, red (#C00000), large font size, split into two lines as shown.
4. Add a second text box centered directly below the title with text: '(Weights from previous layer to Hidden layer)'. Format as regular sans-serif, blue (#0000CC), smaller font size. Apply underline formatting to the word 'previous' and the phrase 'Hidden layer'.
5. Insert a yellow circle (#FFD966) at the top-right corner containing the black number '13'.
6. Add a solid black horizontal bar (#000000) along the entire bottom edge of the slide.
